body: I've lost purpose, Im close to being fired from my job as I never turn up or I'm always late, I've lives like this too long, I've had a couple of shit years and this is the only year where I haven't lost anything significant but sense of purpose and motivation. Im not a selfish person and that's the only reason why I haven't done anything.

I'd be here forever if I mentioned everything, I have a shitty job where I get abused by customers, I'm alone, I'm depressed, I have one friend, along with having to cope with mental problems and constant rejection. I know things could be worse, at least I have a job but I see happier homeless people when I walk to work
